36	@dataclass
37	class EvalPhaseSummary:
38	    name: str
39	    total_cases: int = 0
40	    passed: int = 0
41	    failed: int = 0
42	    errors: int = 0
43	    pass_rate: float = 0.0
44	    avg_duration_ms: float = 0.0
45	    details: list[EvalCaseResult] = field(default_factory=list)
46	
47	    def finalize(self) -> None:
48	        if self.total_cases > 0:
49	            self.pass_rate = round(self.passed / self.total_cases, 3)
50	        durations = [item.duration_ms for item in self.details]
51	        if durations:
52	            self.avg_duration_ms = round(sum(durations) / len(durations), 2)
53	
54	    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
55	        data = asdict(self)
56	        data["details"] = [item.to_dict() for item in self.details]
57	        return data
